/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.from: Our [Icefields Parkway and Jasper shared tour](/shared-tours-icefields-jasper) is a 10 to 12 hour day with a maximum of 12 guests, starting from CAD $249 per person with Parks Canada entry included.
/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.to: Our [Columbia Icefield Adventure shared tour](/shared-tours-icefields-jasper) is a 9 to 11 hour day with a maximum of 15 guests, starting from CAD $220 per person (CAD $320 from June 1 to October 10) with Parks Canada entry included.

/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.from: The day covers Bow Lake, Peyto Lake, Crowfoot Glacier, Weeping Wall, the Athabasca Glacier, Sunwapta Falls, Athabasca Falls and Tangle Falls, with pickup in Banff or Canmore. Ice Explorer and Skywalk tickets are optional extras.
/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.to: The day covers Bow Lake, Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake and Waterfowl Lakes on the way to the Columbia Icefield, with pickup in Banff or Canmore. From June 1 to October 10 the day includes the Ice Explorer onto the Athabasca Glacier and the Columbia Icefield Skywalk.

/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.from: One thing to know: the shared tour runs from June to November and **returns to Banff the same day**. It is a sightseeing day trip, not a one-way transfer, so if you are moving your luggage to Jasper you will want a private tour or a separate transfer.
/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.to: One thing to know: the shared tour turns around at the Columbia Icefield and **returns to Banff the same day**. It does not continue to Jasper town and is not a one-way transfer, so if you are moving your luggage to Jasper you will want the bus, a rental car or a separate transfer.

/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.from: Our [Icefields Parkway and Jasper private tour](/icefields-jasper-private-tour) starts from CAD $999 per group, with up to 6 guests in an SUV or up to 12 in a van. It runs year-round, includes Parks Canada fees and doorstep pickup in Banff, Canmore or Lake Louise, and you can **choose to return to Banff or be dropped off in Jasper** with your bags.
/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.to: Our [Columbia Icefield Adventure private tour](/icefields-jasper-private-tour) starts from CAD $1,240 per vehicle (CAD $1,750 from June 1 to October 10), for up to 13 guests. It runs year-round, includes Parks Canada fees and doorstep pickup in Banff, Canmore or Lake Louise, and **brings you back to Banff, Canmore or Lake Louise** at the end of the day. Like the shared tour, it goes as far as the Columbia Icefield and does not continue to Jasper town.

/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.from: Already in Jasper, or want to spend more of the day around Maligne Lake and Spirit Island? The [customizable Jasper private tour](/icefields-jasper-private-tour) lets you pick any six stops from Jasper and the Parkway.
/blog-post/best-way-to-travel-from-banff.to: Want to see Jasper as well? Our [Four-Day Rockies & Jasper](/four-day-rockies-and-jasper) private journey drives the whole Icefields Parkway to Jasper and adds a day of Jasper highlights before the return transfer.
